tests.name: ubjson_converting_key_basic
tests.intent: Verify that serializing an object with a custom key type convertible to std::string via UBJSON succeeds and produces valid output.

tests.name: bjdata_converting_key_basic
tests.intent: Verify that serializing an object with a custom key type convertible to std::string via BJData succeeds and produces valid output.

tests.name: ubjson_iterative_converting_key
tests.intent: Verify that writing deeply nested objects with a custom key type via UBJSON's iterative writer works properly.

tests.name: bjdata_iterative_converting_key
tests.intent: Verify that writing deeply nested objects with a custom key type via BJData's iterative writer works properly.

tests.name: ubjson_error_handler_strict
tests.intent: Verify that UBJSON binary output with strict error handling throws when encountering invalid UTF-8 in keys.

tests.name: gen_06
tests.intent: Instantiate object_key_string_t with a standard string_t key type to test the conditional branch where key_type is string_t.

tests.name: gen_07
tests.intent: Instantiate object_key_string_t with a custom key type that is not string_t, triggering the non-string_t branch of object_key_string_t conditional type definition.

tests.name: gen_08
tests.intent: Test sanitize_utf8_for_write directly via public binary serialization using standard string_t, reaching the valid template overload.

tests.name: gen_09
tests.intent: Use detection idiom via SFINAE to inspect whether sanitize_utf8_for_write can be invoked with a non-string_t type, exercising the deleted template overload compile-time constraint guard context.

tests.name: gen_10
tests.intent: Exercise object_key_string_t and binary serialization paths using ordered_json to ensure standard key_type behaves identically with string_t matching type optimization.
